description: The games on CrystlQuant's board today and tomorrow, in start order: each matchup, its start time and CrystlQuant's pick, with a link to each game's page. The board carries no chances; each game's CrystlQuant chance, the market's chance and the gap are on the game's page.

limit.description: How many rows to return (1-25, default 15).

sport.description: Optional. One sport: nfl = NFL, nba = NBA, football = Football (soccer), mma = UFC / MMA, mlb = MLB, nhl = NHL, ncaaf = College football, ncaab = College basketball.

name: todays_board
title: Today's board
